designationHistory.indexText: Johns NWR was established on August 16, 1971, to provide habitat for threatened and endangered species, specifically for the conservation of the dusky seaside sparrow ( Ammodramus maritimus nigrescens ).
designationHistory.note: The refuge page does not say how it was established.
